svg.title: Easy-read AI company architecture
svg.desc: A simplified view of the owner request, company lanes, broker, specialist agents, review, approval, and delivery flow.

g.text: One file. Larger text. Fewer words. Three sections: unified flow, company map, and how each agent works.
How the company is grouped into lanes
Stable roles • dynamic model routing • Claude / Codex / approved models
Same simple pattern for every role
